name: Makro
summary: Calm, airy finance-clarity SaaS page: cool blue-grey ground, a cut-out portrait beside a light Inter Display headline, a large soft dashboard below, and a single acid-lime accent on button tabs, highlights and one testimonial card.

fonts.pairing: Inter Display 400 everywhere with -0.04em tracking on headings (88 jumbo H1, 56 H2); body 18/1.5 at 75% ink; a handwritten Havana script only for one tiny annotation

signature: buttons built as a dark pill with a separate acid-lime square holding the arrow icon
acid-lime highlighter block behind one word of each H2
feature panels with misty blue-grey to blush gradients where small white UI cards float like paper
sticky stacked feature rows that pin and swap as you scroll
dark rounded testimonials slab with a full acid-lime case card next to a blush one in a carousel
imagery: one cut-out studio portrait fading into the page, soft desaturated UI renders (balance charts, invoice chips, bill cards), small editorial photos for blog cards, greyed placeholder client marks
layout_grid: 1200 canvas, 40px side padding, 24px gaps, 3-column bento of tall rounded panels, 12px and 24px radii, very tall sections with sticky interiors
